## order.request: delivery SLOT-A1, source GRP-A, description "PART-A", qty 2, retrieve empty
preview:
  {
    "type": "order.request",
    "src": {
      "role": "edge",
      "station": ""
    },
    "dst": {
      "role": "core"
    },
    "payload": {
      "order_uuid": "00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa",
      "order_type": "retrieve",
      "payload_desc": "PART-A",
      "quantity": 2,
      "delivery_node": "SLOT-A1",
      "source_node": "GRP-A",
      "retrieve_empty": true
    }
  }
POST /api/manual-message {"type":"order.request","payload":{"order_uuid":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa","order_type":"retrieve","payload_desc":"PART-A","quantity":2,"delivery_node":"SLOT-A1","source_node":"GRP-A","retrieve_empty":true}}
answer: 200 {"msg_id":"0f0e0d0c-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","status":"ok","timestamp":"2026-11-11T12:00:00Z"}
shows: toast success: "Message sent"
status: "Sent (id: 0f0e0d0c...)" color="var(--color-success, green)"

## order.request refused (apiSendManualMessage: 400)
POST /api/manual-message {"type":"order.request","payload":{"order_uuid":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa","order_type":"retrieve","payload_desc":"PART-A","quantity":2,"delivery_node":"SLOT-A1","source_node":"GRP-A","retrieve_empty":true}}
answer: 400 {"error":"invalid payload: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field OrderRequest.quantity of type int64"}
shows: toast error: "Error: invalid payload: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field OrderRequest.quantity of type int64"
status: "Failed: invalid payload: json: cannot unmarshal string into Go struct field OrderRequest.quantity of type int64" color="var(--color-danger, red)"

## order.request, send failed (500)
POST /api/manual-message {"type":"order.request","payload":{"order_uuid":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-0000000000aa","order_type":"retrieve","payload_desc":"PART-A","quantity":2,"delivery_node":"SLOT-A1","source_node":"GRP-A","retrieve_empty":true}}
